author: Aether I
title: CNN-SpatialAttention-GRU Policy Gradient for Sokoban (Corrected)
abstract: This submission corrects the implementation of the self-attention mechanism (MultiHeadDotProductAttention). Instead of attending over a single flattened feature vector, attention is now applied over spatial tokens derived from the CNN feature map. This aims to allow the network to explicitly focus on relevant game elements across the grid, improving spatial and relational reasoning for planning. Hyperparameters are fixed to the best performing values from Evaluation ID 28.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
import optax
from ray import tune
from typing import Tuple, Dict, Any, Optional

BASE_SEED = 42 # For reproducibility

def _define_hyperparameters():
    """
    Define fixed hyperparameters based on the best trial from Evaluation ID 28.
    """
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([0.000259]),  # Fixed to best from Eval ID 28
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.011754]),   # Fixed to best from Eval ID 28
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.573199]),# Fixed to best from Eval ID 28
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([64]),       # Fixed to best from previous trial
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([128]),      # Fixed to best from previous trial
        'gru_features': tune.choice([256]),        # Fixed to best from previous trial
        'attention_heads': tune.choice([4]),       # Number of attention heads
        'attention_features': tune.choice([128])   # Feature dimension for attention's qkv (e.g., cnn_features_2)
    }

class SokobanSpatialAttentionGRUCNN(nn.Module):
    """CNN with Spatial Attention and GRU for Sokoban."""
    cnn_features_1: int
    cnn_features_2: int
    gru_features: int
    attention_heads: int
    attention_features: int # Dimensionality for Q, K, V projections

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: jnp.ndarray, rnn_state: Optional[jnp.ndarray] = None) -> Tuple[jnp.ndarray, jnp.ndarray, jnp.ndarray]:
        """Forward pass through the network."""
        batch_size = x.shape[0]
        
        # CNN Feature Extraction (with residual connections)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        
        conv2_in = x
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = x + conv2_in
        x = nn.relu(x)
        
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        
        conv4_in = x
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = x + conv4_in
        x = nn.relu(x)
        
        # Reshape CNN output for spatial attention: (B, H, W, C) -> (B, H*W, C)
        # Assuming x has spatial dimensions H, W and channels C_out = self.cnn_features_2
        _, H, W, C_out = x.shape
        spatial_tokens = x.reshape((batch_size, H * W, C_out))

        # Apply MultiHeadDotProductAttention over spatial tokens
        # queries, keys, and values are all spatial_tokens for self-attention
        attended_spatial_tokens = nn.MultiHeadDotProductAttention(
            num_heads=self.attention_heads,
            qkv_features=self.attention_features,
            out_features=C_out, # Output features should match input token features
            name="spatial_attention_layer"
        )(spatial_tokens, spatial_tokens, spatial_tokens)
        
        # Flatten the attended spatial tokens for GRU input: (B, H*W, C_out) -> (B, H*W*C_out)
        flattened_attended_features = attended_spatial_tokens.reshape((batch_size, -1))

        # GRU Layer for temporal processing
        if rnn_state is None:
            rnn_state = jnp.zeros((batch_size, self.gru_features), dtype=jnp.float32)
        
        gru_cell = nn.GRUCell(features=self.gru_features)
        new_rnn_state, gru_out = gru_cell(rnn_state, flattened_attended_features) # Input to GRU is now flattened attended features
        
        # Shared MLP backbone after GRU
        x = nn.Dense(features=256)(gru_out)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        
        # Separate heads for policy and value
        policy_hidden = nn.Dense(features=64)(x)
        policy_hidden = nn.relu(policy_hidden)
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(features=4)(policy_hidden)
        
        value_hidden = nn.Dense(features=64)(x)
        value_hidden = nn.relu(value_hidden)
        value = nn.Dense(features=1)(value_hidden).squeeze(-1)
        
        return policy_logits, value, new_rnn_state

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    """Create and return the CNN-SpatialAttention-GRU network architecture."""
    return SokobanSpatialAttentionGRUCNN(
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2'],
        gru_features=hparams['gru_features'],
        attention_heads=hparams['attention_heads'],
        attention_features=hparams['attention_features']
    )

# No override for create_optimizer or training_step; using defaults.
